pound.Name: Pound
pound.Description: You crush a creature with a pound attack. Make a melee attack roll against a target, doing 1d6 + MOVE normal damage on a hit.
pound.Higher_Levels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 1d12 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

karate-chop.Name: Karate-chop
karate-chop.Description: You extend a hand towards a target creature for a savage karate chop. Make a melee attack roll, doing 1d8 + MOVE fighting damage on a hit. Karate Chop scores a critical hit on 19s and 20s.
karate-chop.Higher_Levels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 4d4 at level 10, and 3d10 at level 17.

double-slap.Name: Double-slap
double-slap.Description: You reach out with quick slaps. Make a melee attack roll, doing 1d4 + MOVE on a hit. After successfully hitting a target, roll a d4. On a result of 3 or 4, another slap lands (add an additional damage dice). Continue this process until you fail to roll a 3 or 4 on the d4 roll, up to a maximum of four additional hits.
double-slap.Higher_Levels: The damage dice rolls for this move change to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 1d12 at level 17.

comet-punch.Name: Comet-punch
comet-punch.Description: You strike out with a series of lightning fast punches. Make a melee attack roll. The target takes 1d4 + MOVE normal damage on a hit. After successfully hitting a target, roll a d4. On a result of 3 or 4, another punch lands (add an additional damage dice). Continue this process until you fail to roll a 3 or 4 on the d4 roll, up to a maximum of four additional dice.
comet-punch.Higher_Levels: The damage dice rolls for this move change to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 1d12 at level 17.

mega-punch.Name: Mega-punch
mega-punch.Description: You strike out with a hard punch Make a melee attack against a target, doing 2d6 + MOVE normal damage on a hit.
mega-punch.Higher_Levels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 2d8 at level 5, 4d6 at level 10, and 6d6 at level 17.

pay-day.Name: Pay-day
pay-day.Description: You strike a target, causing it to shake out its purse. Make a melee attack, doing 1d6 + MOVE normal damage on a hit. In addition, 10x the user’s level in cash is scattered on the floor until the end of combat. This release of funds can only occur once per target.
pay-day.Higher_Levels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 1d12 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

fire-punch.Name: Fire-punch
fire-punch.Description: You strike out with fire-infused fists. Make a melee attack roll, doing 1d12 + MOVE fire damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 19 or 20, the target is burned.
fire-punch.Higher_Levels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 2d8 at level 5, 2d12 at level 10, and 6d6 at level 17.

ice-punch.Name: Ice-punch
ice-punch.Description: You strike out with ice-infused fists. Make a melee attack roll, doing 1d12 + MOVE ice damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 19 or 20, the target is frozen.
ice-punch.Higher_Levels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 2d8 at level 5, 2d12 at level 10, and 6d6 at level 17.

thunder-punch.Name: Thunder-punch
thunder-punch.Description: Your punches are imbued with electric energy. Make a melee attack on a target, doing 1d12 + MOVE electric damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 19 or 20, the target is paralyzed.
thunder-punch.Higher_Levels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 2d8 at level 5, 2d12 at level 10, and 6d6 at level 17.

scratch.Name: Scratch
scratch.Description: You slash out at a creature in range. Make a melee attack, doing 1d6 + MOVE normal damage on a hit.
scratch.Higher_Levels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 1d12 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

vice-grip.Name: Vice-grip
vice-grip.Description: You crush a creature with a forceful, gripping attack. Make a melee attack, doing 1d8 + MOVE normal damage on a hit, grappling the target. On each successive turn, if the creature is still grappled, you may use this move again (as an action) and automatically hit. A creature may attempt to escape the grapple at the beginning of its turns with a STR save against your Move DC.
vice-grip.Higher_Levels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 4d4 at level 10, and 3d10 at level 17.

guillotine.Name: Guillotine
guillotine.Description: You are filled with an incredible rage, grabbing the head of a target creature in an attempt to squeeze the life from it. Roll a d20. Upon rolling higher a 16 or higher deal 8d12 normal damage that bypasses Protect/Detect, but regardless of whether the move hits or not, take disadvantage on all attacks directed towards you until the beginning of your next turn. If the target's level is 10 more than your own, this move automatically fails.

razor-wind.Name: Razor-wind
razor-wind.Description: When you use this move, strong winds begin to circle around you, granting +2 to AC. On your next turn, if you keep your concentration, you release those winds as an action in a 20 foot radius, centered on you. Each creature in the area must make a DEX save against your Move DC, taking 2d6 + MOVE normal damage on a fail, or half as much on a success.
razor-wind.Higher_Levels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 2d8 at level 5, 4d6 at level 10, and 6d6 at level 17.

swords-dance.Name: Swords-dance
swords-dance.Description: When you activate this move, a sword appears and dances around you, increasing your AC by 1. As a bonus action on a future turn, you may drop concentration to release this sword and roll a ranged attack at a target within 30 feet of you, dealing 2d6 + MOVE normal damage on a hit.
swords-dance.Higher_Levels: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d8 at level 5. At level 10, you can now create two swords for +2 to AC and two ranged attacks. At level 17, the damage dice for each sword increases to 3d8.

cut.Name: Cut
cut.Description: You lash out at a target with vine or claw or blade. Make a melee roll on a target, doing 1d8 + MOVE on a successful hit.
cut.Higher_Levels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 4d4 at level 10, and 3d10 at level 17.

gust.Name: Gust
gust.Description: You create a strong wind that batters a target in range. Make a ranged attack, doing 1d6 + MOVE flying damage on a hit.
gust.Higher_Levels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 1d12 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

wing-attack.Name: Wing-attack
wing-attack.Description: You strike out at a target creature with your wings. Make a melee attack roll, doing 1d10 + MOVE flying damage on a hit.
wing-attack.Higher_Levels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 2d8 at level 5, 5d4 at level 10, and 4d8 at level 17.

whirlwind.Name: Whirlwind
whirlwind.Description: You create a whirlwind of spinning air around you, increasing your AC by +2 until the beginning of your next turn. When you activate this move, any creature within 5 feet of you must succeed on a STR saving throw against your Move DC or fall prone. In wild creature battles, this move can be activated to automatically count as a single success in a group DEX check to run away.

fly.Name: Fly
fly.Description: You fly high into the air to prepare for a dive bomb attack. When you activate this move, you use 10 feet of your movement to vanish and fly upwards, remaining in an invulnerable state until your next turn. During this time, you are immune to the damage and effects of any move. If you have no remaining movement or are grappled/restrained before activating this move, the move fails. On your next turn, you use your action to reappear and make a diving melee attack on a creature in range, with advantage, dealing 2d8 + MOVE flying damage on a successful hit.
fly.Higher_Levels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 2d10 at level 5, 3d10 at level 10, and 4d12 at level 17.

bind.Name: Bind
bind.Description: You attempt to grapple a target into submission. Make a melee attack roll. On a hit, the target takes 1d4 + MOVE normal damage and is grappled. At the beginning of each of its turns, it may attempt to escape with a STR save against your Move DC. While a creature is grappled, you may continue this move, as a bonus action, to do an automatic 1d4 normal damage without having to make an attack roll.
bind.Higher_Levels: The damage dice rolls for this move to 1d6 at level 5, 1d8 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

slam.Name: Slam
slam.Description: You crush a creature with a slam attack. Make a melee attack roll against a target, doing 2d6 + MOVE normal damage on a hit.
slam.Higher_Levels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 2d8 at level 5, 4d6 at level 10, and 6d6 at level 17.

vine-whip.Name: Vine-whip
vine-whip.Description: You extend a sharp vine to whip the target with. This vine can strike anything within 15 feet of you. Make a melee attack roll, doing 1d6 + MOVE grass damage on a hit.
vine-whip.Higher_Levels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 1d12 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

stomp.Name: Stomp
stomp.Description: You raise your feet up for a stomp attack. Make a melee attack roll against a target, doing 1d10 + MOVE normal damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is 18 or more, the target flinches.
stomp.Higher_Levels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 2d8 at level 5, 5d4 at level 10, and 4d8 at level 17.

double-kick.Name: Double-kick
double-kick.Description: You strike twice with two devastating kicks. Make two melee attack rolls, doing 1d6 + MOVE fighting damage on each successful hit.
double-kick.Higher_Levels: The damage dice rolls for this move changes to 1d12 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

mega-kick.Name: Mega-kick
mega-kick.Description: You strike with a powerful kick. Make a melee attack against a target, doing 2d10 + MOVE normal damage on a hit.
mega-kick.Higher_Levels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d10 at level 10, and 7d8 at level 17.

jump-kick.Name: Jump-kick
jump-kick.Description: You leap into the air to deliver a strong kick to a creature. Make a melee attack against a target, doing 4d4 + MOVE fighting damage on a hit. On a miss, you take 2 damage. And, the recoil damage increases by 1 for each damage dice increase.
jump-kick.Higher_Levels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 2d10 at level 5, 3d10 at level 10, and 6d6 at level 17.

rolling-kick.Name: Rolling-kick
rolling-kick.Description: You swing your feet around in a wide arc to strike a target. Make a melee attack roll, doing 1d10 + MOVE fighting damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is 18 or more, the target flinches.
rolling-kick.Higher_Levels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 2d8 at level 5, 5d4 at level 10, and 4d8 at level 17.

sand-attack.Name: Sand-attack
sand-attack.Description: You kick up a cloud of sand in an attempt to blind a target in range. The target must make a CON save against your Move DC. On a fail, for the remainder of the encounter, they add -1 to all of their attack rolls. This move can be stacked for a maximum of -5 to attack rolls.

headbutt.Name: Headbutt
headbutt.Description: You really know how to use your head. Make a melee attack roll, doing 1d12 + MOVE normal damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is 18 or more, the target falls prone.
headbutt.Higher_Levels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 2d8 at level 5, 2d12 at level 10, and 6d6 at level 17.

horn-attack.Name: Horn-attack
horn-attack.Description: You strike at a target with your horn. Make a melee attack, doing 1d10 + MOVE normal damage on a hit. If you moved 20 feet or more straight towards a target, immediately before activating this move, force a creature to make a STR save against your Move DC or be knocked prone.
horn-attack.Higher_Levels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 2d8 at level 5, 5d4 at level 10, and 4d8 at level 17.

fury-attack.Name: Fury-attack
fury-attack.Description: You reach out and unleash relentless strikes against a creature. Make a melee attack roll, doing 1d4 + MOVE normal damage on a hit. After successfully hitting a target, roll a d4. On a result of 3 or 4, another strike lands (add an additional damage dice). Continue this process until you fail to roll a 3 or 4 on the d4 roll, up to a maximum of four additional dice.
fury-attack.Higher_Levels: The damage dice rolls for this move change to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 1d12 at level 17.

horn-drill.Name: Horn-drill
horn-drill.Description:
You attempt to drill your horn through a target creature with tremendous strength.
Choose a target in range and roll a d20. Upon rolling a 16 or higher deal 8d12 normal type damage that bypasses Protect/Detect, but regardless of whether the move hits or not, take disadvantage on all attacks directed towards you until the beginning of your next turn. If the target's level is 10 more than your own, this move automatically fails.

tackle.Name: Tackle
tackle.Description: You rush forward and slam into a creature. Make a melee attack roll against a target, doing 1d6 + MOVE normal damage on a hit.
tackle.Higher_Levels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 1d10 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 5d4 at level 17.

body-slam.Name: Body-slam
body-slam.Description: You thrust yourself towards a creature in an attempt to crush them with your physical size. Make a melee attack on a target. On a hit, the target takes 2d6 + MOVE normal damage, and must succeed on a STR saving throw against your Move DC or be knocked prone.
body-slam.Higher_Levels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 2d8 at level 5, 4d6 at level 10, and 6d6 at level 17.

wrap.Name: Wrap
wrap.Description: You attempt to grapple a target into submission. Make a melee attack roll. On a hit, the target takes 1d4 + MOVE normal damage and is grappled. At the beginning of each of its turns, it may attempt to escape with a STR save against your Move DC. As long as the target is grappled on your subsequent turns, this move can be activated again as a bonus action with an automatic hit, dealing 1d4 normal damage.
wrap.Higher_Levels: The damage dice rolls for this move change to 1d6 at level 5, 1d8 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

take-down.Name: Take-down
take-down.Description: You sacrifice your own position to take down a creature. Roll a melee attack roll. On a hit, you deal 2d8 + MOVE normal damage, taking a quarter of the total damage (rounded down) in typeless recoil.
take-down.Higher_Levels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 2d10 at level 5, 3d10 at level 10, and 4d12 at level 17.

thrash.Name: Thrash
thrash.Description: You thrash about wildly, doing several attacks without control. Make a melee attack roll, doing 1d10 + MOVE normal damage on a hit. After successfully hitting a target, roll a d4. On a result of 3 or 4, you may immediately hit again for an additional 1d10 normal damage. Continue this process until you fail to roll a 3 or 4 on the d4 roll, up to a maximum of two additional hits. At the end of this attack, you become confused.
thrash.Higher_Levels: The damage dice rolls for this move change to 2d8 at level 5, 2d10 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

double-edge.Name: Double-edge
double-edge.Description: You commit a massive attack against a creature. Make a melee attack against a target, doing 2d10 + MOVE normal damage on a hit, but taking a quarter of the total damage (rounded down) in typeless recoil.
double-edge.Higher_Levels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d10 at level 10, and 7d8 at level 17.

tail-whip.Name: Tail-whip
tail-whip.Description: You shake your tail at a target, distracting it and opening up its defenses. The creature must make a WIS save against your Move DC. On a fail, allies add +1 to any attack they target it with for the duration. This modifier can be stacked if it fails multiple tail whip saves, up to a maximum of +5.

poison-sting.Name: Poison-sting
poison-sting.Description: You strike out at a creature with a poisonous sting. Make a melee attack roll against a target within range, doing 1d6 + MOVE poison damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is 18 or more, the creature is poisoned.
poison-sting.Higher_Levels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 1d12 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

twineedle.Name: Twineedle
twineedle.Description: You fire two sharp projectiles at a creature in range. They do not have to target the same creature. Make two ranged attack rolls, dealing 1d4 + MOVE bug damage on each hit. If the natural roll of either attack is a 19 or 20, the target is poisoned.
twineedle.Higher_Levels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 2d4 at level 5, 1d12 at level 10, and 4d4 at level 17.

pin-missile.Name: Pin-missile
pin-missile.Description: You strike a creature with sharp projectiles in quick succession. Make a ranged attack roll, doing 1d4 + MOVE bug damage on a hit. After successfully hitting a target, roll a d4. On a result of 3 or 4, another missile lands (add an additional damage dice). Continue this process until you fail to roll a 3 or 4 on the d4 roll, up to a maximum of four additional dice.
pin-missile.Higher_Levels: The damage dice rolls for this move change to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 1d12 at level 17.

leer.Name: Leer
leer.Description: You stare down a target, reducing its will. The creature must make a WIS save against your Move DC. On a fail, allies may add +1 to any attack they target it with for the duration. This modifier can be stacked if it fails multiple leer saves, up to a maximum of +5.

bite.Name: Bite
bite.Description: You sink your teeth into a target creature. Make a melee attack roll, doing 1d10 + MOVE dark damage on a successful hit. On natural attack rolls of 19 or 20, the target flinches.
bite.Higher_Levels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 2d8 at level 5, 5d4 at level 10, and 4d8 at level 17.

growl.Name: Growl
growl.Description: You target a creature with an intimidating growl. The creature must make a WIS save against your Move DC. On a fail, it adds -1 to any attack it makes for the duration. This modifier can be stacked if it fails multiple growl saves, up to a maximum of -5.

roar.Name: Roar
roar.Description: You release an intimidating roar at all opponents within 15 feet of you. Opponents that can hear you must make a WIS save against your Move DC. On a fail, the creature is frightened and is forced to immediately move up to its speed in a straight line away from you, or until met with an impending force (does not provoke attacks of opportunity). A creature frightened in this way must make a WIS save against your Move DC at the end of each of its turns to remove the effect.

sing.Name: Sing
sing.Description: You sing a beautiful song in an attempt to put creatures to sleep. Roll 5d8, the total is how many hit points of creatures this move can affect. Creatures within 30 feet of you are affected in ascending order of their current hit points. Starting with the creature that has the lowest current hit points, each creature affected by this move falls asleep. Subtract each creature’s hit points from the total before moving on to the creature with the next lowest hit points. A creature’s hit points must be equal to or less than the remaining total for that creature to be affected.
sing.Higher_Levels: The number of hit points affected changes to 7d8 at level 5, 6d12 at level 10, and 11d8 at level 17.

supersonic.Name: Supersonic
supersonic.Description: You emit a high pitched screech heard only by the target. Choose a target in range. The target must pass a WIS saving throw against your Move DC or become confused.

sonic-boom.Name: Sonic-boom
sonic-boom.Description: You unleash a deafening sound that harms creatures in a 40 foot circle, centered on you. Creatures in range must make a CON save against your Move DC, taking 20 flat normal damage on a fail, or half as much on a success.

disable.Name: Disable
disable.Description: You attempt to disable a target, hindering its moves. Choose a target in range. The target must succeed on a WIS saving throw against your Move DC. On a failed save, the last Move it activated is unable to be used while you hold your concentration. (If this would end Solar Beam, Skull Bash, etc. during the charge phase of the Move, the Move automatically fails on the target's next turn)

acid.Name: Acid
acid.Description: You create a stream of hot acid in a 30-foot cone, centered on you. Creatures caught in the cone must make a DEX save, taking 1d6 + MOVE poison damage on a failure, and half as much on a success.
acid.Higher_Levels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 1d12 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

ember.Name: Ember
ember.Description: You hurl a ball of flame at a target within range. Make a ranged attack, doing 1d6 + Move fire damage on a successful hit. If the natural attack roll is 19 or 20, the target is burnt.
ember.Higher_Levels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 1d12 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

flamethrower.Name: Flamethrower
flamethrower.Description: You shoot a concentrated gout of flame in a 40 foot cone. Any creature caught in the cone must succeed on a DEX save against your Move DC, taking 2d8 + MOVE fire damage on a failure, or half damage on a success. Any creature that fails the save by 5 or more becomes burned.
flamethrower.Higher_Levels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 2d10 at level 5, 3d10 at level 10, and 4d12 at level 17.

mist.Name: Mist
mist.Description: A light mist surrounds a target, offering a protective barrier. The target is immune to negative stat changes for the duration, but any current effects are still in place.

water-gun.Name: Water-gun
water-gun.Description: You fire a quick spurt of water at a creature in range. Make a ranged attack roll, doing 1d6 + MOVE water damage on a hit.
water-gun.Higher_Levels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 1d12 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

hydro-pump.Name: Hydro-pump
hydro-pump.Description: You send a surge of powerful water towards creatures in a 80 foot line, 5 feet wide. Creatures caught in the blast must succeed on a DEX save against your Move DC, taking 3d6 + MOVE water damage on a failed save, and half as much on a success.
hydro-pump.Higher_Levels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 6d6 at level 10, and 7d8 at level 17.

surf.Name: Surf
surf.Description: You summon a fast-moving wave in front of you that crashes down on creatures in a 30 foot cone. Any creature caught in the blast must make a STR saving throw, taking 2d8 + MOVE water damage and falling prone on a failure, or half as much without falling prone on a success.
surf.Higher_Levels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 2d10 at level 5, 3d10 at level 10, and 4d12 at level 17.

ice-beam.Name: Ice-beam
ice-beam.Description: You create a 80 foot line of freezing ice, 5 feet wide. Any creature caught in the line must succeed on a DEX save against your Move DC or take 2d8 + MOVE ice damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. Creatures that fail this save by 5 or more become frozen.
ice-beam.Higher_Levels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 2d10 at level 5, 3d10 at level 10, and 4d12 at level 17.

blizzard.Name: Blizzard
blizzard.Description: Icy clouds form overhead and pelt the ground with hail and snow, centered on a point you choose within range. Each creature in a 30 ft radius, centered on a point within range, must make a DEX saving throw against your Move DC, taking 3d6 + MOVE ice damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Targets that fail the save by 5 or more become frozen. During a hailstorm, targets become frozen if they fail the save by 3 or more.
blizzard.Higher_Levels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 6d6 at level 10, and 7d8 at level 17.

psybeam.Name: Psybeam
psybeam.Description: You send a beam of invisible, psychic energy at a target in range. The target must make a WIS saving throw against your Move DC, taking 2d6 + MOVE psychic damage on a fail, or half as much on a success. Creatures that fail the save by 5 or more become confused.
psybeam.Higher_Levels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 2d8 at level 5, 4d6 at level 10, and 6d6 at level 17.

bubble-beam.Name: Bubble-beam
bubble-beam.Description: You shoot a concentrated stream of bubbles at a single creature in range. Make a ranged attack roll, doing 1d10 + MOVE water damage on a hit. On natural attack rolls of 19 or 20, the target's speed is halved until the end of their next turn.
bubble-beam.Higher_Levels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 2d8 at level 5, 5d4 at level 10, and 4d8 at level 17.

aurora-beam.Name: Aurora-beam
aurora-beam.Description: You send a concentrated beam of freezing ice at a single creature in range. Make a ranged attack roll, doing 1d10 + MOVE ice damage on a hit. On natural attack rolls of 15 or higher, the target has disadvantage on any attack it makes on its next turn.
aurora-beam.Higher_Levels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 2d8 at level 5, 5d4 at level 10, and 4d8 at level 17.

hyper-beam.Name: Hyper-beam
hyper-beam.Description: You unleash a concentrated beam of pure energy in a 80 foot line, 5ft wide. Any creature caught in the line must succeed on a DEX save or take 3d8 + MOVE normal damage on a fail and half as much on a save. This move cannot be used on consecutive turns by the same creature.
hyper-beam.Higher_Levels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 5d6 at level 5, 4d12 at level 10, and 8d8 at level 17.

peck.Name: Peck
peck.Description: You hammer down on a target with a peck attack. Make a melee attack roll on a target, doing 1d6 + MOVE flying damage on a successful hit.
peck.Higher_Levels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 1d10 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 5d4 at level 17.

drill-peck.Name: Drill-peck
drill-peck.Description: You hammer down on a target with a peck attack. Make a melee attack roll on a target, doing 2d6 + MOVE flying damage on a successful hit. Drill Peck scores a critical hit on 19s and 20s.
drill-peck.Higher_Levels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 2d8 at level 5, 4d6 at level 10, and 6d6 at level 17.

submission.Name: Submission
submission.Description: You attempt a forceful grapple on a target. Make a melee attack, doing 2d6 + MOVE fighting damage on a hit, but taking a quarter of the damage dealt in recoil. On a hit, the target is grappled. At the beginning of each of its turns, it may attempt to escape with a STR save against your Move DC. While a creature is grappled, this move can be activated again as a bonus action with an automatic hit, dealing 2d6 fighting damage with a quarter of the damage dealt in typeless recoil.
submission.Higher_Levels: The damage dice rolls for this move change to 2d8 at level 5, 4d6 at level 10, and 6d6 at level 17.

low-kick.Name: Low-kick
low-kick.Description: You kick out at a creature’s lower half, dealing damage and attempting to knock it off balance. Make a melee attack, dealing 1d10 + MOVE fighting damage on a hit. If the target's size is Large or bigger, double the dice roll for the damage. On a natural attack roll of 19 or 20, the target falls prone.
low-kick.Higher_Levels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 2d8 at level 5, 5d4 at level 10, and 4d8 at level 17.

counter.Name: Counter
counter.Description: When you are hit by a melee attack, you can use your reaction to make a melee attack against the creature, doing 1d4 + MOVE fighting damage on a successful hit.
counter.Higher_Levels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 1d6 at level 5, 1d8 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

seismic-toss.Name: Seismic-toss
seismic-toss.Description: You attempt to throw a creature into the ground with tremendous force. Make a melee attack roll. On a hit, deal an amount of fighting damage equal to 1d6 + the user’s level. Seismic Toss results in a critical hit on 19s and 20s.
seismic-toss.Higher_Levels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 1d10+Level at level 5, 2d8+Level at level 10, and 5d4+Level at level 17.

strength.Name: Strength
strength.Description: You strike out at a creature with brute strength. Make a melee attack roll, doing 2d6 + MOVE normal damage on a hit. On a hit, you may also choose to push the creature 5 feet away.
strength.Higher_Levels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 2d8 at level 5, 4d6 at level 10, and 6d6 at level 17.

absorb.Name: Absorb
absorb.Description: You attempt to absorb some of a target’s health. Make a melee attack on a creature within range. On a hit, the creature takes 1d4 + MOVE grass damage. Half the damage done is restored by the user.
absorb.Higher_Levels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 2d4 at level 5, 1d12 at level 10, and 4d4 at level 17.

mega-drain.Name: Mega-drain
mega-drain.Description: You attempt to drain the life force of a target. Make a melee attack against a target in range, dealing 1d6 + MOVE grass damage on a hit. Half of the damage dealt is restored to the user.
mega-drain.Higher_Levels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 1d12 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

leech-seed.Name: Leech-seed
leech-seed.Description: You send a seed at a creature in range that implants itself in their hide. Make a ranged attack roll. On a hit, a seed implants into their skin. The target takes 1d4 grass damage at the end of each of its subsequent turns until it faints or is switched out. Half of the damage is restored by the attacker, or any other active creature the trainer has in battle, even if the original attacker faints or is returned to its Pokéball. Only one creature can be seeded by the attacker at a time. Grass-type creatures are immune to the damage from this move.
leech-seed.Higher_Levels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 2d4 at level 5, 2d6 at level 10, and 2d8 at level 17.

growth.Name: Growth
growth.Description: You increase the size of a target. When you use this move, a creature in range (or you) grows slightly larger, gaining the ability to add a d4 to any attack roll or saving throw for the duration.
growth.Higher_Levels: The dice to add increases to 1d6 at level 10.

razor-leaf.Name: Razor-leaf
razor-leaf.Description: You send a razor sharp leaf at a creature in range at tremendous speed. Make a ranged attack roll, doing 1d8 + MOVE grass damage on a hit. Razor Leaf results in a critical hit on 19s and 20s.
razor-leaf.Higher_Levels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 5d4 at level 10, and 3d10 at level 17.

solar-beam.Name: Solar-beam
solar-beam.Description: When you use this move, soak in solar energy and prepare to unleash a devastating beam. On your next turn, if you keep your concentration, use an action to create a 80 foot line of solar energy, 5 feet wide. Any creature caught in the line must succeed on a DEX save or take 3d8 + MOVE grass damage on a fail and half as much on a save. If this move is used in harsh sunlight, double your original, base MOVE modifier for damage and it can be used on the turn it is activated, without concentration.
solar-beam.Higher_Levels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 5d6 at level 5, 4d12 at level 10, and 8d8 at level 17.

poison-powder.Name: Poison-powder
poison-powder.Description: You release a cluster of poisonous spores that burst into the air above a target. The creature must succeed on a CON save against your Move DC, becoming poisoned on a fail.

stun-spore.Name: Stun-spore
stun-spore.Description: You release a mixture of spores that are specialized in numbing the movements of creatures. Force a creature in range to make a CON saving throw, they are paralyzed on fail.

sleep-powder.Name: Sleep-powder
sleep-powder.Description: You release a cluster of spores at a creature in range, attempting to put them to sleep. The target must make a CON saving throw against your Move DC or fall asleep.
